data.name: RunProfilesIntro
data.value: Run Profiles define what operations can be performed on a Connector, i.e. import, export and synchronization, with any required settings.

data.name: RunProfileVerificationModeHelp
data.value: Runs the honest attribute diff on every object instead of skipping unchanged objects by content hash, and reports any disagreement between the stored hash and the diff as an error. Use temporarily to validate the content-hash skip optimization; leave off for normal, faster Full Imports.

data.name: ScimEndpointInfo
data.value: Give your identity provider this base URL and one of the keys below. The Users and Groups it sends are kept here and reach the Metaverse at the next import and synchronization of this Connected System.

data.name: DetailInfoBody
data.value: A Connected System is one system JIM imports from or exports to, with its connection settings, schema, Run Profiles and the objects JIM holds for it.

data.name: DetailDeprovisioningDetail
data.value: This system is being deleted through synchronization and is excluded from scheduled runs; configuration is read-only until the run completes.

data.name: DetailDeprovisioningStoppedDetail
data.value: A Synchronized Deprovisioning run did not finish, so this system remains fenced and excluded from scheduled runs; the work already done stands. Deleting the system again with {0} resumes from where the run stopped; {1} finishes the deletion at once.

data.name: DetailImportIncompleteDetail
data.value: An import of this Connected System began saving what it read on {0} UTC and did not finish, so the Connector Space holds only part of it. Full and Delta Synchronization of this Connected System will not run until it is whole again.

data.name: DetailObsoleteSingle
data.value: 1 Connected System Object is obsolete. It was not returned by the last Full Import, so the next Synchronization Run Profile on this system will disconnect it from their Metaverse Objects and delete it.

data.name: DetailObsoleteMany
data.value: {0} Connected System Objects are obsolete. They were not returned by the last Full Import, so the next Synchronization Run Profile on this system will disconnect them from their Metaverse Objects and delete them.

data.name: DetailSweepArmedReady
data.value: A stranded-value sweep is armed: the Connector Space was cleared on {0} UTC and a Full Import completed on {1} UTC. The next Full Synchronization of this Connected System will recall values contributed by objects that did not return.

data.name: DetailSweepArmedWaiting
data.value: A stranded-value sweep is armed: the Connector Space was cleared on {0} UTC. It will run at the first Full Synchronization after a Full Import of this Connected System completes successfully; a Full Synchronization run before then does nothing beyond ordinary synchronization.

data.name: DetailDriftOneDated
data.value: 1 configuration change has been made since the last Full Synchronization ({0}).

data.name: DetailDriftOneUndated
data.value: 1 configuration change has been made since the last Full Synchronization.

data.name: DetailDriftManyDated
data.value: {0} configuration changes have been made since the last Full Synchronization ({1}).

data.name: DetailDriftManyUndated
data.value: {0} configuration changes have been made since the last Full Synchronization.

data.name: DetailDriftGuidanceDestructiveSingle
data.value: It is destructive and can cascade deletions or mass deprovisioning the moment it is applied. Review it before running a Full Synchronization.

data.name: DetailDriftGuidanceDestructiveMany
data.value: At least one of them is destructive and can cascade deletions or mass deprovisioning the moment it is applied. Review them before running a Full Synchronization.

data.name: DetailDriftGuidanceSingle
data.value: Run a Full Synchronization for it to take effect.

data.name: DetailDriftGuidanceMany
data.value: Run a Full Synchronization for them to take effect.

data.value: Preview Full Synchronization

data.name: DetailNeverSynchronised
data.value: This Connected System has never completed a Full Synchronization, so its configuration has never been applied in full.

data.name: DetailTrackingOff
data.value: Configuration change tracking is switched off, so JIM cannot tell whether this Connected System has configuration changes waiting for a Full Synchronization.

data.name: ConnectedSystemDeprovisionThroughSynchronisation
data.value: Deprovision through synchronization

data.name: DeleteSystemFencedAttached
data.value: A Synchronized Deprovisioning run for this system is already queued or running. {0} attaches to it, resuming from its checkpoint; {1} abandons the remaining deprovisioning and completes the deletion at once.

data.name: DeleteSystemFencedWarning
data.value: A previous Synchronized Deprovisioning run stopped before completing and this system remains fenced. {0} resumes from where the run stopped; {1} finishes the deletion at once, keeping the remaining contributed data.

data.name: DeleteSystemDeprovisionDetail
data.value: Each of this system's objects is processed as though it had disconnected through a normal synchronization: contributed values are recalled or handed to surviving contributors, Metaverse Object deletion rules are evaluated for objects losing their last connector, and downstream systems receive corrective exports. Runs as a queued operation you can monitor from the Operations page; deleting the system is its final step.

data.name: DeleteSystemImmediateDetail
data.value: The system is removed at once. Values it contributed remain in place with no record of where they came from; Metaverse Object deletion rules are evaluated in bulk for objects losing their last connector, but no per-object synchronization processing occurs; downstream systems are not corrected.

data.name: DeleteSystemImmediatePreviewNote
data.value: This preview describes deprovisioning through synchronization. Deleting immediately clears none of these values and sends no exports; Metaverse Objects whose last connector is this system still become eligible for deletion under their Object Type's deletion rule.

data.name: DeleteSystemImpactSyncRules
data.value: Synchronization Rules

data.name: PwPanelPolicyInfo
data.value: The password rules this Connected System enforces, read when the schema was last retrieved. JIM uses them to pre-fill the initial password settings on a Synchronization Rule, so the rules do not have to be retyped.

data.name: PwPanelOutcomeNotPublished
data.value: This directory publishes no password policy that JIM can read. There is nothing to configure here: the initial password settings on a Synchronization Rule are set by hand, and a password the directory refuses is reported when it happens.

data.name: PwPanelOutcomeNotRead
data.value: JIM has not read a password policy from this Connected System. Retrieve the schema to read the policy, if there is one; where a directory publishes none, the initial password settings are configured by hand on the Synchronization Rule.
